name: classmate-membershiplinks-rules-verification
description: Self-contained Firestore Rules Unit Testing harness for the membershipLinks rule (Phase 1 — Membership Identity Foundation). NOT part of the ClassMate application itself, and NOT run by the app's own `node --test` suite (see this directory's own README for exactly why). Copy this whole directory, plus the real ../firestore.rules it reads, to a machine with normal network access, then follow the README.
